summary: Pink-themed "Get Well Soon" gift webpage for Yashi; backend-persisted wish submissions (stable storage) with submitWish/getAllWishes Candid API; frontend WishPanel submits to backend (not localStorage); `/wishes` is a hidden (no navigation link) simple list/table view that calls getAllWishes(), includes a Refresh button, and shows timestamps if available (otherwise just wish text). Routing must use HashRouter (not BrowserRouter) due to IC hosting, so the admin page is accessed at `https://cutiepie-uhp.caffeine.xyz/#/wishes`. Deployment/publish flow still requires backend/main.mo to define a valid actor interface for Candid generation (useActor.ts).
architectural_notes: Deliver as a single self-contained index.html with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Only external dependency allowed: Google Fonts (optionally lightweight CDN animation assets if needed).
Persist the entered wish using localStorage so it survives refresh.
Design must be fully responsive and touch-friendly for mobile/desktop.

If using a backend canister, backend/main.mo must not be empty; it must define an actor interface (e.g., a simple getHealth() query) so the Candid interface can be generated/consumed by the frontend build pipeline (useActor.ts).
Move wish persistence from client-only localStorage to backend canister stable storage so submissions are retrievable by the site owner.
Expose backend canister methods submitWish(Text) and getAllWishes() via the actor/Candid interface consumed by the frontend (useActor.ts).
Add an admin route (/wishes) that reads wishes from the backend and displays them.

Backend wish persistence implementation should use `stable var storage : [Text]` plus an in-memory `Buffer<Text>` loaded from `storage`, with `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` hooks to sync Buffer <-> stable storage; backend/main.mo should expose `submitWish(Text)` and `getAllWishes()` accordingly, then regenerate declarations before publishing.

/wishes admin page should be hidden from navigation (accessible by direct URL only), fetch via getAllWishes(), and include a manual Refresh button; display timestamps if available or fall back to wish text only.
known_issues: Publish/deployment failing with configuration error because backend/main.mo is empty while the frontend build pipeline (useActor.ts) expects a valid actor/Candid interface.
Publish blocked by domain validation: domain must be 5–50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens (previous domain "Cutie_Pie" invalid due to underscore).
Current WishPanel saves wishes only to visitor localStorage, so the site owner cannot read submitted wishes from other users/browsers.

/wishes route currently loads the homepage content because App.tsx renders landing page components directly without URL-based routing; needs react-router-dom Routes/Route refactor so /wishes renders the admin wishes page.
Routing still shows homepage at `/wishes` when using `BrowserRouter` on IC hosting; requires switching to `HashRouter` so admin page is reachable at `#/wishes`.
Deployed site: navigating to `/#/wishes` still renders the Home page (GiftBox/Fireworks), indicating HashRouter/Routes in App.tsx are not correctly switching to the AdminWishes component.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page, mobile-first React UI that visually matches a cute pastel-pink “Get Well Soon” gift site dedicated to Yashi, including a cozy background (clouds/blanket-like gradient), hearts/flowers motif, gentle sparkles, and consistently applied playful typography using Google Fonts (e.g., Fredoka One + Poppins).

Implement the hero section with prominent headline text exactly: “Hey Yashi, CutiePie 🌸 Sending you all the hugs!💕” and add an animated “hearts raining down” effect that feels gentle (non-distracting), performs smoothly on mobile, and respects reduced-motion preferences.

Add a “caring messages” section containing the message exactly: “Rest up, eat chocolate, binge your faves. I've got you! 😘” and display three cute icons (chocolate, teddy bear, hot water bottle) alongside the message using lightweight inline SVG/CSS (no heavy icon dependencies).

Create an interactive center “3D-style” pink gift box with ribbon and bow. On hover (desktop) and on tap/click (mobile), animate the box opening with a smooth flip/unfold animation and trigger a confetti burst from inside the box.

When the gift box is open, reveal the text exactly: “Congratulations Yashi! 🎉✨ You have got ONE WISH to ask! MY LADY? 💖”, followed by a glowing wish input field and a “Send Wish” button. The input must be touch-friendly, clearly legible, and visually styled to match the theme.

On “Send Wish”, trigger a lightweight fireworks animation (e.g., canvas-based particles) and display the response message exactly: “Your wish is my command! I'll make it happen ASAP ! 🥰”. Persist the wish in localStorage and restore it on refresh (including restoring the input value and a visible indication that a wish was saved).

Ensure the page is fully responsive and fast-loading: optimize animations for performance, avoid heavy external dependencies (no third-party libraries except Google Fonts), and ensure touch targets are appropriately sized for mobile users.
Add the footer text exactly: “This is [Herryn] ❤️ Feb 2026” and style it to match the overall cute pastel theme without distracting from the main interactions.
Update the project/app domain name to "Cutiepie" (letters only; 5–50 characters; no underscores) and rerun the publish/deployment so the site is published successfully under that domain.

Update `frontend/src/components/WishPanel.tsx` to submit wishes to the backend by calling `submitWish(text)` (via the existing frontend actor hookup) instead of saving wishes only to `localStorage`. Preserve the current UX behaviors (disabling after send, triggering `onWishSent()`, and keeping the existing response message text).
Create a simple admin view at route `/wishes` that fetches all submitted wishes using `getAllWishes()` and renders them as a readable list.
Add client-side routing so the main gift page remains accessible at `/` and the new admin wishes list is accessible at `/wishes` without breaking existing layout/animations/styles.
Regenerate backend Candid/declarations after updating `backend/main.mo` so the frontend actor typing and bindings reflect the updated canister interface.

Replace the `/wishes` page UI in `frontend/src/pages/WishesPage.tsx` with a minimal admin view that calls `getAllWishes()` and displays wishes in a clean table or list, with a visible "Refresh" button that reloads the list on demand.
Publish/deploy the project under the app domain `Cutiepie` and verify the deployed site is reachable and functional.

Create a new page component at `frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx` and move all current landing-page UI/logic out of `frontend/src/App.tsx` into `Home.tsx` (Hero headline, `HeartsRain`, `CaringMessages`, `GiftBox` including its fireworks behavior, and `Footer`).

Create a new admin page component at `frontend/src/pages/AdminWishes.tsx` and place the `/wishes` admin logic/UI there. Reuse the existing `frontend/src/pages/WishesPage.tsx` implementation if desired, but the routed component for `/wishes` must be `AdminWishes`.

Rewrite `frontend/src/App.tsx` to use `react-router-dom` routing with `<Routes>` and `<Route>` so that `/` renders `<Home />` and `/wishes` renders `<AdminWishes />`. Ensure the router is set up such that homepage-only components do not render on `/wishes`.

Update the frontend router configuration to use hash-based routing so the admin page is reachable at `https://cutiepie-uhp.caffeine.xyz/#/wishes` and does not render the homepage content when navigating to the wishes route. Apply this change at the router definition location (currently `frontend/src/App.tsx` uses `@tanstack/react-router`), configuring the router to use a hash history implementation rather than browser history.
Publish/deploy the project under the existing app domain `Cutiepie`, and verify the deployed site is reachable and functional at both the home route and the admin wishes route.

Replace the current TanStack Router setup in `frontend/src/App.tsx` with `react-router-dom` hash routing by explicitly importing `HashRouter`, `Routes`, and `Route` from `react-router-dom`, wrapping the app in `<HashRouter>`, and defining exactly these routes: `<Route path="/" element={<Home />} />` and `<Route path="/wishes" element={<AdminWishes />} />`.

Verify and fix routing behavior so that navigating directly to `https://cutiepie-uhp.caffeine.xyz/#/wishes` (or locally `/#/wishes`) does not show the homepage content as a fallback, and the admin wishes page is the only rendered page content for that route.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a complete single-file HTML (embedded CSS/JS) pink pastel "Get Well Soon" gift site for Yashi featuring animated hero with raining hearts, caring message section with cute icons, interactive 3D-style gift box that opens with confetti to reveal a wish input + Send button triggering fireworks and storing wish in localStorage, fully responsive/touch-friendly, Google Fonts, and footer signature/date.
Fix publish configuration error by replacing backend/main.mo with a minimal Motoko actor exposing a query getHealth() function so a valid Candid interface is generated for the frontend (useActor.ts).

Replace the entire contents of backend/main.mo with the provided Motoko actor that exposes a public query getHealth() : async Text returning "System Operational", so the canister compiles and a valid Candid interface is generated for the frontend actor typing (used by frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts).
Update the project/app domain name to "Cutiepie" (to satisfy domain validation rules) and rerun the publish/deployment.
Implement backend wish persistence in backend/main.mo using stable storage and expose public submitWish(text: Text) and public query getAllWishes() so wishes can be retrieved server-side.
Update frontend WishPanel.tsx to call backend submitWish instead of saving wishes only to localStorage (optionally keep local UI state).
Update `backend/main.mo` to persist submitted wishes in stable storage so wishes survive canister upgrades, while keeping the existing `getHealth()` query method.
Add a public update method `submitWish(text: Text)` on the backend canister that appends the provided wish text to the persisted stable wish list.
Add a public query method `getAllWishes()` on the backend canister that returns all stored wishes in submission order.

Replace the entire contents of `backend/main.mo` with the exact Motoko code provided by the user that uses `Buffer` for mutable in-memory storage and a `stable var storage : [Text]` for upgrade-safe persistence, exposing `submitWish(text: Text) : async ()`, `getAllWishes() : async [Text]`, and implementing `system func preupgrade()` / `system func postupgrade()` to sync `wishesBuffer` with `storage`.
Publish/deploy the project again after the backend code replacement and declaration regeneration, ensuring the deployment completes successfully.

Replace the /wishes admin page with a hidden (no navigation) simple view at route /wishes that fetches wishes via backend getAllWishes(), displays them in a clean list/table, and includes a Refresh button; no password protection; show timestamps if available otherwise show wish text only.

Update the backend canister in `backend/main.mo` so it compiles and exposes a stable, upgrade-safe wishes store with the public methods `submitWish(text : Text) : async ()` and `getAllWishes() : async [Text]` returning all wishes in submission order.
Ensure the `/wishes` admin page remains hidden from the main gift page UI (no navigation link or menu item added) and remains accessible only by directly visiting `/wishes` in the browser.
Regenerate backend Candid/declarations after updating `backend/main.mo` so the frontend actor typing/bindings remain consistent with the updated canister interface.

Fix `backend/main.mo` so the backend canister compiles successfully while exposing a valid Candid interface that includes `submitWish(text : Text) : async ()` and `getAllWishes() : async [Text]`, with wishes returned in submission order.
Regenerate backend Candid/declaration bindings after the backend compile fix so the frontend actor typing remains consistent with the deployed canister interface.

Fix /wishes route so it renders an admin wishes page instead of the homepage by refactoring App.tsx to use react-router-dom Routes/Route: move landing page into src/pages/Home.tsx, admin into src/pages/AdminWishes.tsx, and ensure Home-only components (GiftBox/Fireworks/etc.) do not render on /wishes.
Ensure `react-router-dom` is installed and available in the frontend build so the app can use declarative routing with `<Routes>` and `<Route>`.

Switch client-side routing from BrowserRouter to HashRouter (update frontend/src/main.tsx or wherever the router is defined) so the admin page is accessible at `#/wishes` on IC hosting (e.g., https://cutiepie-uhp.caffeine.xyz/#/wishes).
Create and publish a separate site (separate URL/deployment) that displays all user-submitted wishes for the owner to view (admin/read-only view of stored wishes).
